description: Fetch metadata for WHO GHO indicator codes: the canonical code, full name, and supported dimensions (e.g. COUNTRY, REGION, SEX, YEAR, WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP, AGEGROUP). Call this before who_query_indicator_data to confirm valid filter dimensions. Processes the first 10 entries and returns unprocessedCodes to submit next, accepting at most 1000 raw entries. With GHO_CLAMP_LIMITS=false, calls above 10 reject. Many valid indicators have no dimension listing upstream — those return an empty dimensions array with dimensionsNote. Processed codes absent from both the catalog and dimension table appear in notFound. No found entries raises all_not_found only when no unprocessed entries remain.

indicator_codes.description: Indicator codes, e.g. ["WHOSIS_000001", "MDG_0000000026"]. Processes the first ten and returns remaining entries for the next call; at most 1000 entries.

name: who_get_indicator_metadata

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `all_not_found`: No processed indicator code resolved and no unprocessed codes remain. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

indicators.description: Metadata for each code that resolved to a catalog entry or dimension rows.

dimensions.description: Dimensions this indicator supports for filtering in who_query_indicator_data. Empty when the GHO dimension table lists none for this code — see dimensionsNote.

items.description: A dimension entry supported by this indicator.

dimensionsNote.description: Present only when dimensions is empty: explains that the listing is missing upstream rather than the indicator being absent, and how to recover the dimensions from a sample data row.

indicatorCode.description: Canonical catalog code when resolved; otherwise the requested dimension-only code.

indicatorName.description: Decoded catalog name; the code itself when only dimension metadata resolves.

notFound.description: Indicator codes that resolved to neither a catalog name nor any dimension rows — they do not exist in the GHO catalog.

unprocessedCodes.description: Remaining request entries in their original order. Submit these codes next.

title: Get WHO GHO Indicator Metadata
